{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}")

# Check how many unique patients there are
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f"Number of unique patients: {unique_patients}")

# Check how many rows have sample_seq > 1 (re-tests)
retest_rows = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print(f"Number of re-test rows: {len(retest_rows)}")

# Check the distribution of severity
df['severity'].value_counts(dropna=False)"}
